facts.text: I want to know how parents can encourage their kids to get involved in fundraising activities to support a meaningful cause.
I like the idea of setting a goal for fundraising.
I want to make sure my child doesn't get discouraged if they don't reach the fundraising goal.
I want suggestions on how to make fundraising more fun and engaging for my child.
I love the idea of creating a game or contest around the fundraising activity.
I want suggestions on what kind of game or contest would work well for fundraising.
I love the idea of having a bake sale competition.
I want to involve other local businesses in the bake sale competition.
I want local businesses to donate sweets or baked goods to the bake sale.
I think involving local businesses will make the bake sale competition more exciting.
I can't wait to see what kind of sweets and baked goods local businesses will donate.
I think involving local businesses can help spread awareness about the cause.
I want tips on how to effectively promote the bake sale competition and the cause it supports.
